title: EPAAA: highlights, duration, start date and fee
content:
### Program Highlights & Fees (EPAAA)
Program Duration | 6 Months
Program Begins | 25 July 2026
Learning Hours | 90 Hours
Online Classes | 75 Hours (Sat - 3 hours / week)
Campus Immersion | 15 Hours (2 Days)
Number of Online Sessions | 25 Sessions
Who should attend | Working professional after Graduation
Program Fee | INR 50,000 + GST (18%)
